title: Daily Dose #388: A Gift for the Common Good
body:
**“To each is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common good.”**

Spiritual gifts are not trophies proving that one Christian matters more than another. They are ways God enables His people to serve.

The church in Corinth had turned gifts into comparison and status. Paul reminded them that the same Spirit gives different gifts and that every part of the body is needed.

Your gift is not only about personal fulfilment. Ask whether it strengthens, teaches, encourages, helps or protects others. A gift used without love can become noise, no matter how impressive it appears.

Do not despise what God has given you because it looks ordinary. Do not exaggerate it to gain attention. Use it faithfully for the common good.

A gift becomes fruitful when it becomes service.
